title: Get Procedural 3D Working End to End
description: Get procedural 3d working end to end. Currently the window shows: Renderfehler: Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component repeatedly calls setState inside componentWillUpdate or componentDidUpdate. React limits the number of nested updates to prevent infinite loops.
summary: Fixed procedural 3d end-to-end crash showing "Renderfehler: Maximum update depth exceeded". Two React 19 loops: (1) @radix-ui/react-slider@1.3.6 unstable composed refs on thumbs — bumped to 1.4.5 with root override; (2) useCanvasAppearanceSync depended on unstable inline sync callbacks from Flow/Preview hosts, so each paintOverlays setState retriggered the effect — fixed by sync-ref in ui-react. Also guarded UtilityTree path reconcile and paintOverlays size/json setState equality. Verified on :6018: Flow+Preview render, hexagonal column preview, 3 sliders, slider drag, depthErrorCount 0; vitest for appearance-sync identity passes.
